- id=15: G, 3 pixels, boundary=[[27, 9], [27, 11]] - this is a horizontal bar at row 27, cols 9-11

What if the goal is to make the green container 3 pixels tall (matching the green indicator bar) and the yellow bar 3 pixels wide (matching the yellow indicator bar)?

Hmm, what if the goal is to make the green container have the same ORIENTATION as the green indicator bar (vertical), and the yellow bar have the same orientation as the yellow indicator bar (horizontal)?
But the green container is always vertical (3 tall, 2-5 wide), and the yellow bar is always horizontal (2-8 tall, 3 wide). So this also doesn't make sense.
OK, I'm really stuck. Let me try one more thing: what if I need to click on the U-shapes to cycle through all 6 combinations, and the level completes after I've visited all of them?
Actually, that doesn't make sense either, because the level would have completed by now.
